title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Exodus 1: Israel's growth in Egypt, the new king's oppression and the brave Hebrew midwives.

questions.text: How many souls came out of Jacob's body?
questions.explanation: All the souls who came out of Jacob's body were seventy, and Joseph was already in Egypt.

questions.text: What is said about the new king who arose over Egypt?
questions.explanation: A new king arose over Egypt who didn't know Joseph.

answers.text: He had been raised by Jacob

questions.text: What did the king fear the Israelites might do if war broke out?
questions.explanation: The king feared that in a war they would join Egypt's enemies, fight against them and escape out of the land.

answers.text: Join Egypt's enemies and fight against them
Return to Canaan to crown a king

questions.text: Which storage cities did the Israelites build for Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Taskmasters were set over Israel, and they built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.

questions.text: What happened the more the Egyptians afflicted the Israelites?
questions.explanation: The more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and spread out, and the Egyptians began to dread them.

answers.text: They began to worship Egypt's gods
They multiplied and spread out even more

questions.text: With what kind of hard work did the Egyptians make Israel's lives bitter?
questions.explanation: They made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and brick, and in all kinds of service in the field.

questions.text: What were the names of the two Hebrew midwives?
questions.explanation: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, one named Shiphrah and the other Puah.

questions.text: Why did the midwives not do what the king commanded?
questions.explanation: The midwives feared God and did not do what the king commanded, but saved the baby boys alive.

answers.text: They were paid by the Hebrews
They did not understand the order
The king's order never reached them

questions.text: What reason did the midwives give Pharaoh for the boys being saved?
questions.explanation: They said the Hebrew women are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.

answers.text: The Hebrew women hid their babies in the reeds
The Hebrew women give birth before the midwife arrives
The boys were born in the land of Goshen
The king's soldiers had stopped them

questions.text: What did Pharaoh finally command all his people to do?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh commanded his people to cast every son born into the river and to let every daughter live.

answers.text: Send all Hebrew men into the army
Double the work of the Israelites
Drive the Israelites out of Egypt
Cast every newborn son into the river
